title: Framework repo sanitized: WAI-Spoke/ gitignored with auto-init from template on first session
signal: WAI-Spoke/ is now fully gitignored in the framework repo. Personal session data, lugs, and state never committed. Auto-init hook creates WAI-Spoke/ from templates/spoke/WAI-State.json.template on first Claude session. All hardcoded /home/mario paths replaced with env vars. Personal data archived to hub/spokes/framework/. This changes the distribution model: clone gets clean framework, WAI-Spoke bootstraps on first use.
rationale: Fundamental change to how the framework distributes. Enables true open-source release without PII leakage. Every spoke should adopt this pattern — WAI-Spoke/ is runtime data, not source code.
scope_verified_by: user (Session 103: 'it shouldnt store my WAI-Spoke in the repo')

_behavior_directive.what_this_is_NOT: Not an instruction to execute. Route and store only.
